messages:
jamal: quick favor — opened PR #4872 that adjusts batching window logic + small KV cache ttl change. want a quick safety pass before i merge to main. aiming to ship a tiny perf rollback tonight.
liz: sending eyes now. what's the risky bit?
sanjay: is this the change that alters batcher max_wait_ms from 8 -> 12 for long tails?
jamal: yep — default increases to reduce tiny batches, plus added a fallback route when kv-prefetch hits a collision. also fixed a race in kv::insert that could drop a prefix under rare interleavings.
liz: big picture lgtm but want to run a local smoke with small model. can you paste the exact command you used for the repro?
jamal: sure:

```
# repro load for flaky prefix drop
RUNTIME_ENV=local ./bin/run_infer --model tests/models/tiny --trace batcher,kv --requests ./tests/data/prefix_race.json
```

jamal: CI shows one flaky test failing in integration that looks related to timing. ci-bot reported the failure, linked above in the PR checks.
ci-bot: CI check: integration-smoke (flaky) — 1 failed, 12 passed. Logs: https://ci.company/4872/logs
liz: can you add a tiny defensive check in kv::insert to bail if state mismatches? that would make the upgrade safer.
jamal: added the nil-check in the branch, pushed a new commit. also added a unit test that simulates concurrent insert+evict. PTAL.
sanjay: quick read — code looks good. one minor nit: comment on why 12ms chosen (mention workload seen in prod) would help future readers.
jamal: added comment and a short note in the PR description about the observed p50/p95 batch sizes and network RTTs that motivated this.
liz: ran the local smoke with your command and couldn't reproduce the prefix drop after your fix. local perf numbers look neutral.
sanjay: i can do a quick canary deploy on staging at 00:30 UTC if you want to validate traffic patterns with real routing.
jamal: yes please — if staging looks fine we want to merge before the release cutoff at 01:15 UTC. also set the rollout to 10% then 100% if stable.
liz: approved on github. leaving comment about watch windows. :thumbsup:
sanjay: approved. i'll kick the staged rollout and watch batcher metrics (batch_size, deferred_requests, kv_collisions). pinging on-call.
ci-bot: Deploy triggered: staging rollout (10%). Monitor: https://monitoring.company/dashboards/batcher
jamal: thanks both — merging once staging 10% is green. will post update in #eng-runtime when it's at 100%.
liz: nice. also add a note in the release notes about the TTL change (small compatibility note) so infra knows.
jamal: added release note. will follow up with a brief postmortem if the flaky shows again. thanks!"
